description: List archived deals with the same filtering as the active deals list (owner, person, organization, pipeline, stage, status). Returns paginated results.

custom_fields.description: Include custom fields in response (comma-separated field keys or 'all')

include_fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields (v2 enum, e.g. next_activity_id, last_activity_id, products_count, files_count, notes_count, followers_count)

limit.description: Number of items to return (1-100, default 50)

status.description: Filter by deal status (omit to return all non-deleted deals)

updated_since.description: Filter deals updated after this time (RFC3339 format, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

updated_until.description: Filter deals updated before this time (RFC3339 format)

name: pipedrive_list_archived_deals
